# Control Center backend (backend/) dependencies.
# Generated by inspecting every import across backend/*.py, backend/collectors/*.py
# and backend/routes/*.py, then pinned to versions verified working in the real
# dev environment - not copied from a template. Windows-only app; several of
# these (pywin32, wmi, the winrt/winsdk media API) have no meaningful use
# outside Windows.
#
#   pip install -r requirements.txt

# HTTP + calendar
requests==2.33.1
icalendar==7.2.2
recurring-ical-events==3.8.2

# Hardware/system stats (CPU/RAM/disk via psutil; GPU via nvidia-ml-py, which
# provides the `pynvml` import; CPU temperature fallback via WMI when
# LibreHardwareMonitor isn't running - both GPU and the WMI fallback degrade
# gracefully to "not available" if the underlying hardware/service isn't
# there, but the packages themselves still need to be installed for that
# code path to run at all instead of raising ImportError)
psutil==7.2.2
nvidia-ml-py==13.610.43
wmi==1.5.1  # pulls in pywin32 itself, no direct pywin32 import in this codebase

# Now Playing (Windows media session API) and system volume control

winrt-Windows.Media.Control==3.2.1
winrt-Windows.Storage.Streams==3.2.1
pycaw==20251023

# Wallpaper accent/palette extraction (Scene)
